description: Turn an inbound B2B manufacturing RFQ / sourcing inquiry into three artifacts: a structured spec sheet, a missing-information clarification checklist, and a professional English reply draft — WITHOUT inventing prices, MOQs, lead times, certifications, stock or test data. Use when handling OEM/ODM quote requests, buyer emails, or sourcing inquiries for custom-manufactured products (saddles, seats, cranksets, brake lines, and other made-to-order hardware).
